description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling membership-related data within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for report display purposes. It provides methods to convert membership data to an array format and defines mappings for data fields.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: A DTO class used for representing and normalizing membership data for report display, associated with a specific employee by employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Membership DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's membership data into an array of specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping from field names to corresponding getter methods for retrieving data.
